mentions.name: LoomDSP
mentions.description: A free and open source modular audio composition environment, inspired by Eurorack modular, VCV Rack, and Bitwig Studio's The Grid. Accepts ideas and bug reports.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a free/open source modular audio composition environment, called LoomDSP. It's inspired by Eurorack modular, VCV Rack, and Bitwig Studio's The Grid.
